## Accordion.item
**Node ID:** 9209:22534

Props
=====

_`**itemHeight:**`_ Choose between compact, default, and tall item heights to update spacing between the accordion items.

  

_`**open:**`_ Display the disclosure icon pointing up, indicating that the controlled content is displayed and will be collapsed/hidden when the Accordion.Item button is activated.

  

When not provided (or when provided with false) the disclosure icon will display pointing down, indicating that the controlled content is hidden and will be expanded/displayed when the Accordion.Item button is activated.

  

_`**❖ State:**`_ The state of the `Accordion.Item`

  

_`**border:**`_ Whether to display the border or not. Defaults to true.

  

_`**disabled:**`_ Disables interaction and applies disabled styling.

  

_`**startElement:**`_ Use to display a leading icon.

  

_`**❖ showSubtitle:**`_ Displays secondary text

  

_`**subtitle:**`_ The `Accordion.Item` button secondary text.

  

_`**❖ showMetadata:**`_ Displays supplemental text

  

_`**metadata:**`_ The `Accordion.Item` button supplemental text.

  

  

Rules

1.  When creating an `Accordion,` add 1px border-bottom borderColorSubtle to the last `Accordion.Item`
